calls.head: Daccord doesn’t own the Blackhawks
calls.body: Since 2023-24, Daccord has been a wall against the Blackhawks, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Blackhawks finally get to him.
calls.call: If Daccord starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .903 than to his .934 against the Blackhawks.

calls.head: The Kraken’s edge in preventing dangerous shots
calls.body: The Kraken are one of the league’s best for preventing dangerous shots, and the Blackhawks are around the middle. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.
calls.call: The Kraken prevent dangerous shots better than the Blackhawks do.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Kantserov has two goals as the Blackhawks hold off the Kraken
paras: Spencer Knight stopped Mackie Samoskevich on a penalty shot just over a minute in. The Blackhawks went more than 19 minutes without a shot on goal, from early in the second to early in the third. Most teams don’t go that long without a shot even once a season. It was a busy third period. Cole Smith opened the scoring for the Hawks early in the period. Roman Kantserov pushed the lead to 2-0 on the power play a minute and a half later, and that one stood up as the winner. With the goalie pulled and just over three minutes left, Jordan Eberle cut Chicago’s lead to 2-1. Kantserov scored again into the empty net with 20 seconds left.
The Blackhawks were outshot 30-19, but their looks were better, and the chances came out about even. Joey Daccord stopped 16 of 18 for the Kraken.
The Blackhawks killed all four Kraken power plays. The Blackhawks improved to 9-14-2, still last in the Central, while the Kraken dropped to 11-10-1, slipping to sixth in the Pacific.
